cover.title: Our pistachio cake, step by step

items.title: Toast the pistachios
items.text: 8 minutes at 160 °C, until they smell sweet.

items.title: Whip the eggs
items.text: Until they triple and fall like a ribbon.

items.title: Fold, don't stir
items.text: Big slow folds keep the air in the batter.

items.title: Bake low and slow
items.text: 160 °C for 35 minutes, then rest 10 in the open oven.
